# BugRicer

BugRicer is an advanced bug tracking and project management platform for development teams, built by [CODO AI Innovations](https://codoacademy.com).

## Public pages

- [Home](https://bugs.bugricer.com/)
- [Home (alias)](https://bugs.bugricer.com/home)
- [Sign in](https://bugs.bugricer.com/login)
- [Privacy Policy](https://bugs.bugricer.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Use](https://bugs.bugricer.com/terms-of-use)

## Product

- Bug reporting with attachments and voice notes
- Project collaboration and role-based access
- Real-time notifications and activity tracking
- Built-in meetings and messaging

## Crawl preferences

- Index public marketing and legal pages listed above
- Do not crawl or train on authenticated workspace routes under `/admin`, `/tester`, `/developer`, `/project_manager`, or `/client`
- Sitemap: [https://bugs.bugricer.com/sitemap.xml](https://bugs.bugricer.com/sitemap.xml)
- Robots: [https://bugs.bugricer.com/robots.txt](https://bugs.bugricer.com/robots.txt)

## Contact
